Are you passionate about building meaningful partnerships and driving impactful sales? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where you can connect the dots between customer needs and innovative solutions? If so, we’d love to hear from you! We are IceWarp . A Czech company providing communication solutions to over 50 million users worldwide.

Our products compete with Google and Microsoft and specialize in innovative technologies such as email, team chat, audio and video conferencing, calendar and contact synchronization, document sharing and collaborative editing.

All these features are available in a unified environment and can be used in major browsers, on desktops and mobile platforms, both in the cloud and on-premises.

We are seeking a Channel Sales Manager to grow and enhance our channel sales initiatives, who will help us with building strong partnerships and with driving revenue through distributor and partner networks.

The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in managing channel relationships, nurturing sales pipelines, and exceeding sales targets through indirect sales channels, bringing both strategic vision and hands-on execution skills within the SaaS industry.

In this role, you will also engage directly with customers and potential customers to understand their needs, nurture relationships and close deals. What You’ll Do: Partner Development & Management: Establish and nurture relationships with distributors and channel partners across Southern Europe to expand IceWarp’s market presence.

Channel Strategy Execution: Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and execute strategic channel plans aimed at driving significant revenue growth. Pipeline Growth: Actively engage with partners to identify opportunities, provide support, and facilitate deals through the sales cycle using CRM (SFDC).

Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to align strategies, messaging and ensure seamless onboarding and support for channel-generated customers. Sales Enablement: Train and empower partners with the knowledge and resources needed to effectively promote and sell IceWarp solutions.

Reporting & Analytics: Regularly monitor, analyze, and report channel sales performance metrics to refine strategies and maximize sales effectiveness. Market Insight: Continuously gather feedback from partners and end-users to enhance our offerings and address market demands effectively.

Partner/Distributor Impact: Listen & Respond: Use feedback from partners and customers to identify and overcome obstacles, ensuring their success. Engage & Support: Promote partner events, encourage participation in surveys, and connect resources to keep the sales pipeline flowing smoothly.

What we offer: Collaboration with a European company whose product is used by over 50 million users worldwide, competing with Google and Microsoft.

The opportunity to come up with new ideas and implement them immediately Long-term cooperation The chance to expand knowledge in various interesting areas 25 days of paid leave 5 Personal days Requirements What We’re Looking For: Experience: At least 3 years of experience in SaaS Channel Sales with a focus on the Italian/Spanish market.

We expect you will know the local partners. Language skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken. Enterprise Partner Sales Manager Location: Remote USA or Remote Canada (with ability to travel to US) Hiring Range: $85,000 - $110,000 CAD + Bonus About Us: Friendlier is a trusted reuse partner for campuses, foodservice operators, and institutions across North America, delivering turnkey reusable packaging systems that simplify the shift away from single-use packaging.

As a fintech company with a vast addressable market, we empower our employees to be thought leaders as they navigate various customer problems – whether internal or external – and to be challenged to develop solutions that create a positive impact for our business.

Rapid Ratings is actively looking for a proven Senior Account Executive (AE) to join our exceptional Sales team and expand our GTM presence in North America. This role reports into the VP of Sales.

The mission of the Senior Account Executive is to help create enterprise value for each customer by deploying our predictive analytics and financial risk reporting systems.

This role has 3 core areas of responsibility: Closing qualified opportunities with high rates of conversion to achieve quarterly and annual quota targets; Progressing pipeline to align business cases with buying cycles, with the sales EQ necessary to both rigorously qualify and disqualify opportunities; and Consistently building new pipeline to replace opportunities won or lost.

This requires a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset to engage with potential customers across all channels.

Success in these areas also relies heavily on keen discovery skills to identify leads with potential business problems that we can solve, as well as effective communication to align multiple stakeholders with a problem that can be solved through Rapid Ratings’ capabilities and value-driven sales process.

A successful Senior Account Executive at Rapid Ratings never stops selling; top reps consistently sell through the first deal to help ensure value delivery after getting the first contract in the door, and driving towards significant Enterprise Growth after adoption is complete.

While this is just one dimension of the overall role for a Senior Account Executive, it is an important element that requires experience in project management and cross-functional leadership to drive growth. The ideal candidate draws from experience in the Supply Chain, Third Party Risk, Credit Risk, or Risk Management fields.

These industries are undergoing rapid change as risk management disciplines evolve, while companies face economic, operational, regulatory, and capital challenges.

Challenges bring opportunities, and Rapid Ratings is critical in guiding the world's leading corporations and financial institutions to proactively manage these risks and to create resilience and business opportunities in the process.

All Account Executives are expected to apply a consultative approach to navigate the sales process and help potential customers identify business gaps in their current risk management programs that can be solved with Rapid Ratings’ solution.

Sales cycles, depending on the deal, can move as quickly as 30-90 days for wins focused on mid-market accounts or “land and expand” strategies, whereas larger enterprise deals will often take 6-9 months to align with the timelines of procurement budget/buying cycles.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Individual Contributor Responsible for qualifying, developing, and closing new opportunities within a list of ~75 strategic accounts in EMEA.

Develops and maintains relationships with key decision makers Develops a business plan and sales strategy (new business) for each branch and major program in the assignment to ensure tactical penetration and Management of leads proved by internal and external BDRs.

Overachievement of quarterly sales quota through selling TPRM, SCRM platform to well-qualified prospects using the Rapid Ratings sales process. Conduct market research and recommend product positioning and pricing strategy.

Manage the development and maintenance of referral-generation plans. 100% certification of Rapid Ratings methods, products and services.

Expectations of Sales Activity: Strategically manage a global territory of Accounts within Rapid Ratings’ core verticals (Auto, Aerospace & Defense, Banking/Insurance, Industrials, HC/Pharma, Technology/Semiconductors), and deploy a lead-generation strategy focused on sourcing new opportunity accounts Work with the assigned Business Development Representative (BDR) to create a support plan for conducting outreach to designated high-value accounts within the assigned territory Focus on activity rate – number of new connections, first calls, meetings, all maintained in Salesforce Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quota objectives Manage pipeline and opportunity stages to be consistent at all times with Rapid Ratings Sales Methodologies and Policy Continuous learning to always improve selling tactics and strategies to increase win % Essential Education, Skills and Environment: Specialized Knowledge and Skills Subject matter expertise in Supply Chain Management, Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM), Third Party Risk Management (TPRM).

Knowledge of GRC solutions is a plus. BA/BS degree (or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree preferred). A verifiable track record of sales quota attainment (Experience and success in Solution Selling or like methodologies in complex environments of 6+ months sales-cycle durations and ARR in excess of $500,000).

Minimum 5 years’ relevant work experience. Domain expertise of SaaS-based solutions is a plus but not a requirement. Outstanding analytical, organizational, communication, presentation and negotiation skills. High comfort level and presence of senior-level executives and decision-makers.

Education Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Administration with a focus on finance, engineering, sales management or logistics preferred. Essential Personal Values and Attributes Hungry, Humble, Capable. Highly competitive and coachable. Ability to work within a team environment.

Ability to independently identify, investigate and develop solutions to problems (business, operational and ideally technical). Ability to manage multiple projects/initiatives to meet predetermined deadlines, setting direction for and ensuring the success of all prospect engagements.

Demonstrated proficiency in software productivity tools (CRM, word processing, spreadsheet, presentation and database software) to meet goals of position. Ability to function independently, with minimal supervision, setting direction communicating effectively with internal and client stakeholders, and enlisting help as needed.

Ability to prioritize and delegate work as needed. Ability to establish friendly, professional and cooperative relations with internal and external contacts. Organizational and Territory Management Skills (strategic thinking, goal-setting, business metrics driven, time management, etc.) What would make you successful?

Experience in Enterprise SaaS, Software Sales or Technology with an understanding MEDDPIC principles, and/or Solution Selling Methodology Challenger mindset and approach to sales Experience in credit, financial risk, or third-party risk more broadly Demonstrated sales process and high IQ/EQ to determine “fit” with potential buyers to ensure sales efficiency Cross-functional experience to work with partners and internals teams to drive opportunities and win deals Proven selling success of meeting or exceeding quotas and goals Strong desire to learn and earn in a fast-paced environment Professional presence as well as outstanding interpersonal, verbal, and written communication and negotiating skills Demonstrable understanding of B2B sales processes.

Willingness to travel 50% of the time Compensation and Benefits Highly Competitive Salary Aggressive Commission Plan Paid Vacation Days Sick Leave Medical/​Dental/​Vision Plans Career Development Support Why join Rapid Ratings?

Here at Rapid Ratings we foster an environment where employees feel recognized for their contributions, appreciated for their individuality, and challenged to do their best.

We know that bringing together employees with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences sparks innovation, promotes better decision making and yields the creative problem solving that is critical to our long-term success.

We offer an attractive benefits package with bonus, flexible working, private health care, pension options and much more. With us, you are not just a number – we value people who are working hard and strive to make a real difference. Join our team to be a part of an industry-changing company and drive your career in the right direction.

About ResearchGate
ResearchGate is where science happens online. Over 26 million researchers globally use our platform to discover groundbreaking research, connect with peers, and advance their work.
What we do matters. By providing the world’s leading pharma, biotech, and scientific organizations with precision digital advertising and content solutions, we connect them directly with the global scientific community.

The partnerships you build will bring vital tools, clinical data, and breakthrough technologies directly to the minds actively solving humanity's most complex medical and scientific challenges. Your work doesn't just drive revenue—it directly accelerates the discoveries that change the course of human history.

We are looking for a high-performing Senior Sales Manager to join our Marketing Solutions department, owning and growing a portfolio of enterprise life science accounts. You will drive full-cycle sales—from strategic outbound prospecting to close— selling high-value digital advertising solutions and custom media campaigns directly to life science marketers and their media agencies.
This is a consultative, multi-stakeholder digital media sale with true deal ownership and a clear sense of purpose. You won't just pitch and pass; you will architect partnerships that connect pioneering life science brands with the global scientific community.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, you will join a high-performing, international, and collaborative commercial team focused on connecting researchers with tools and solutions that accelerate scientific progress.

Drive Ad Revenue: Close net-new and expansion digital advertising business across a dedicated portfolio of pharma, biotech, and scientific brands.
Consultative Media Selling: Run structured, deeply analytical discovery sessions to understand brand objectives and build tailored, insight-led digital media and content strategy proposals .
Navigate Marketer Ecosystems: Confidently pitch to and steer deals through complex brand teams, digital marketing leads, agency partners , and procurement.
Strategic Account Planning: Build and execute long-term account roadmaps to scale our share of wallet and maximize ad spend within key organizations.
Collaborate for Campaign Success: Partner closely with Account Management and Ad Ops to ensure ad campaigns perform flawlessly against client KPIs , securing renewals and long-term retention.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently hitting and exceeding your quarterly advertising revenue quota.
Growing key enterprise accounts year-over-year through strategic digital media upselling.
Delivering high-ROI ad campaigns that naturally convert into predictable, repeat business.

The Track Record : 5+ years of closing experience in B2B digital advertising, ad-tech, digital media sales, or publisher solutions.
Marketer Fluency : Deep understanding of digital advertising metrics (CPM, CTR, lead generation, brand awareness) and how life science marketers allocate budgets.
Industry Context: Experience selling into pharma, biotech, or life sciences—or managing these verticals from an ad agency perspective—is a strong plus.
Pipeline Ownership : A proactive hunter mindset. You are comfortable prospecting, mapping out marketing departments, and building your own pipeline without relying on inbound leads.
Commercial Polish : Strong commercial instinct. You know how to qualify rigorously, multi-thread within complex marketing organizations, and close high-value ad contracts

A Legacy-Defining Mission: Align your sales career with a monumental purpose. Every deal you close helps get vital information and technology into the hands of the pioneers solving the world’s most critical health crises.
Unmatched Digital Reach: Tap into a unique, highly coveted global audience of 26M+ verified researchers that marketers cannot find anywhere else.
Proven Impact: Sell premium first-party ad inventory and native solutions with undeniable product-market fit.
An International, High-Performing Culture: Work alongside a diverse, driven team scaling a world-class platform.
Work Style & Flexibility
We operate with a Digital-First philosophy, meaning our processes and communication are built for flexibility. However, we believe in the power of face-to-face collaboration to build strong team culture:
Berlin Hub: Our team comes together in our vibrant Berlin office 3 days a week .
Work from Abroad : Enjoy the ultimate flexibility with up to 120 days per year of working remotely from abroad.
ResearchGate is an equal opportunity employer
We encourage people from all backgrounds and life experiences to apply with us and help us change the world of science. We commit to impartial and inclusive hiring processes, and therefore ask you to please refrain from adding a picture and your age to your application form or CV.

Our hiring decisions are made based on your skills and qualifications, regardless of your age, gender, origin or race/ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, disability status, religion, or any other (perceived) personal characteristics. We are excited to receive your application.
ResearchGate Intro and Mission
ResearchGate is the largest professional network for scientists and researchers. We've built a platform that helps the world's scientists and researchers to connect, collaborate, and advance their research to drive progress towards a better world. Over 26 million members from 193+ countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research

Votre rôle
En tant que Group Reservation & Sales Manager Multi-Site, vous êtes responsable du développement commercial et de la gestion des groupes pour nos établissements de Sion et de Fribourg.
Véritable interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs et partenaires, vous prenez en charge les dossiers de la première demande jusqu’au départ du groupe et au suivi administratif et financier qui en découle.
Votre rôle combine développement commercial, vente, négociation, gestion des réservations groupes et coordination avec les équipes opérationnelles des deux établissements.
Vos missions

· Prospecter et développer de nouveaux clients groupes : entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs, associations, clubs, etc.

· Développer et fidéliser un portefeuille de clients existants

· Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et marchés à potentiel

· Répondre aux demandes et appels d’offres groupes

· Élaborer des offres commerciales adaptées aux besoins des clients

· Négocier les tarifs, conditions et prestations dans le respect des objectifs de l’établissement

· Effectuer les relances commerciales et assurer un suivi régulier des prospects et clients

· Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires groupes des deux établissements

s.h: GESTION DES GROUPES DE A À Z
s.t:
· Prendre en charge les demandes groupes de la première prise de contact jusqu’au départ

· Préparer les offres, contrats et conditions de réservation

· Gérer les rooming lists, échéances, acomptes et demandes particulières

· Coordonner les prestations complémentaires : restauration, salles, pauses, boissons, etc.

· Centraliser les informations et assurer leur transmission aux équipes concernées

· Anticiper les besoins spécifiques des groupes et proposer des solutions adaptées

· Assurer le suivi du dossier jusqu’à sa clôture

· Effectuer un suivi post-séjour afin de recueillir les retours clients et développer la relation commerciale

· Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers groupes

· Vérifier la conformité des prestations et tarifs facturés avec les offres et contrats

· Assurer le suivi des acomptes et échéances de paiement

· Contrôler les factures et identifier les éventuels écarts ou erreurs

· Effectuer les relances nécessaires en cas de factures ou acomptes impayés

· Collaborer avec la réception et la comptabilité pour assurer le suivi des dossiers

· Assurer le suivi des corrections, avoirs ou éventuelles réclamations liées à la facturation

· Veiller à la clôture administrative et financière des dossiers après le départ du groupe

· Gérer et répartir les demandes groupes entre les établissements de Sion et Fribourg selon les disponibilités et les besoins des clients

· Coordonner les dossiers avec les équipes réception, restauration et direction des différents sites

· Assurer une transmission claire et complète des informations aux équipes opérationnelles

· Veiller au bon déroulement des prestations vendues

· Harmoniser et améliorer les processus de gestion des groupes entre les deux établissements

· Suivre les demandes, confirmations, refus et opportunités commerciales

· Suivre le chiffre d’affaires généré par les groupes

· Analyser les performances et identifier les opportunités de développement

· Maintenir à jour les bases de données clients et le suivi de l’activité commerciale

· Participer aux actions commerciales, rendez-vous clients et événements professionnels
Votre profil

· Expérience dans la réservation groupes, le sales, le développement commercial ou l’événementiel hôtelier

· Expérience dans la gestion de groupes, un réel atout

· Excellent sens commercial et goût du challenge

· Aisance dans la négociation et la relation client

· Très bonnes capacités d’organisation, de suivi et de gestion des priorités

· Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités

· Esprit entrepreneurial, proactivité et force de proposition

· Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément

· Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication

· À l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes de réservation hôteliers

· Connaissance d’Opera Cloud et des outils de gestion hôtelière, un atout

· Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

· Allemand, un réel atout

· Permis de conduire, un plus pour les déplacements entre les deux sites
Particularité du poste
Ce poste s’adresse à une personne ayant une véritable fibre commerciale et souhaitant jouer un rôle actif dans le développement des établissements.
Nous recherchons une personne capable de transformer une demande de groupe en opportunité commerciale, de négocier et vendre les prestations adaptées, puis d’assurer le suivi opérationnel, administratif et financier du dossier jusqu’à sa clôture.
La capacité à prospecter, vendre, fidéliser et développer le chiffre d’affaires est aussi importante que la rigueur nécessaire au suivi des dossiers.

About Dutchie
Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.
Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

As an Account Executive you will support the day-to-day delivery of medical communications projects, working closely with senior account leads to ensure work is delivered on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality and compliance.

The role provides hands-on project coordination across timelines, logistics, financial tracking, databases, and approvals, while following established SOPs to support operational excellence.

It’s an ideal entry-level opportunity for someone looking to build a career in medical communications, develop an understanding of client strategy and the pharmaceutical industry, and contribute to positive client experiences.
Working collaboratively with internal teams, clients, authors, and external partners, the Account Executive helps coordinate meetings, events, materials, and documentation, while maintaining accurate project records and approval workflows in line with Good Publication Practice.

The role also supports basic financial administration, client communication, and post-project learnings, with a strong emphasis on organization, attention to detail, and proactive problem-solving.

This position suits a reliable, detail-oriented individual who is keen to learn, confident using standard office tools, and motivated to grow their skills in a fast-paced, professional agency environment.

Account Management
Support day-to-day account management under the direction of the senior team, ensuring smooth communication and efficient delivery of client work, in line with SOPs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (studio, editorial, creative) to coordinate timely project delivery through the defined SOPs.
Apply and develop knowledge of client products, therapy area, and market context to inform project delivery.
Contribute to post-project debriefs, supporting the SAM/AD in capturing lessons learned and identifying opportunities to enhance client delivery and future project performance.
Support efforts to contribute to the organic growth through quality delivery of assigned accounts.
Take opportunities to build understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, med comms sector, and compliance frameworks relevant to assigned accounts.
Project Management
Develop and manage project timelines, update status trackers, and follow internal processes to ensure smooth, on-time delivery, in line with SOPs and flagging any risks or issues to the SAM/AD through agreed SOP channels.
Coordinate and ensure delivery of live/virtual/hybrid events (e.g. logistics, materials, registrations, supplier liaison).
Coordinate print and shipping coordination, supports the development of on-site packs and pre-meeting materials as required.
Process copyright permission approvals and reference purchasing as required. Order references and ensure these are filed appropriately.
Maintain organized project folders and consistent file naming and sharing practices in line with SOPs.
Perform online and database searches for journal and congress information to support project delivery as required.
Financial Management
Manage financial tracking and invoicing under the guidance of the SAM/AD, including raising job numbers, budget development and tracking, invoicing, and reporting using CMAP (financial data tracking tool).
Track time accurately and record it weekly to support project efficiency and productivity.
Proactively flag any financial or timeline concerns to the SAM/AD to ensure projects remain within budget and on schedule, in line with SOPs.
Client Management
Contribute to delivering high-quality client experiences and demonstrate professionalism in all interactions.
Build strong working relationships with client contacts, authors, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
Prepare client meeting contact reports and status sheet updates and assist in basic project delivery discussions.
Communicate clearly and proactively with clients and internal teams, and ensures all correspondence and documentation comply with Prime’s SOP communication guidance (Teams, email, meeting notes).
Database and Approvals Management
Create records and maintain all aspects of database and approvals management systems, ensuring project records, documents, and approvals are accurately maintained in accordance with Client’s timelines, publication process and publication database guidelines.
Comply with defined approval and quality-control workflow (upload, track, and maintain approval records) to ensure project materials are complete, compliant, and retrievable.
Ensure the database record meets Good Publication Practice guidelines and that all steps are complete, with fully auditable documentation trail.

Proactively identify inconsistencies or missing information and work with internal teams to resolve issues.

More about Nash
Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.
Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one.

Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.
Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network.

Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

s.h: Your role Strategic Account Management & Business Development
s.t:
Relationship: Establish, navigate, and maintain high-level relationships within leading French OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers across the French region, Central Europe, and beyond.
Identify key stakeholders and decision-makers (R&D, Procurement, Quality) to communicate the technical and commercial advantages of Hongfa’s product portfolio.
Strategy Implementation: Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies in collaboration with the Sales Management to exceed annual sales targets and long-term KPIs.
Deal Leadership: Lead the entire sales cycle—from initial hunting and business development to the final closing of major contracts and platform wins.
Market Intelligence & Planning
Market Analysis: Continuously monitor market trends, competitor activities, and technological shifts to identify new project opportunities and "blue ocean" potentials.
Sales Operations: Ensure data integrity by permanently maintaining CRM and SAP systems, including monthly forecast updates, budget planning, and project tracking.
Reporting: Deliver regular, insightful reports on sales performance, pipeline health, and strategic milestones to the executive management.
Project & Acquisition Leadership
Strategic Acquisition ("Hunting"): Proactively identify and win new business opportunities, focusing on high-volume platforms and strategic programs.
RFQ Management: Orchestrate strategic RFQs for new platforms. This includes defining the quotation strategy, coordinating commercial/legal documentation, and aligning with Department Leaders and the Program Management team.
Commercial Negotiation: Define final negotiation strategies and secure commercial commitments. Negotiate at the management level with both the customer and Hongfa’s internal BUs.
Life-Cycle Involvement: Own the strategic relationship during the early acquisition phase and ensure a seamless handover/collaboration with Program Managers.
Representation & Escalation Management
Management Interaction: Represent the account in strategic meetings, including Year-End Reviews, PBD-Analysis, and "Gate" reviews.
Escalation Lead: Act as the primary point of contact for high-level escalations (e.g., Quality/H-ELP issues) to ensure swift resolution and maintain customer trust.
Global Mobility: Travel regularly to customers, international trade fairs, and production facilities to strengthen the partnership and HFE’s brand presence.
